positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Created a standalone service (REST) that serves as a middleman for requesting image or video resources from an IP camera. Service consumes JSON via GET or POST.

● Client sends POST/GET request to server requesting a resource(IMAGE/VIDEO)
● Server reads JSON from request
● Server connects to ip camera and obtains resource
● Server returns resource to Client.

Technologies used: Java Spark, Gradle, Groovy, MySQL, Video Encoding (H.264, MP4)
